The report at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-09_14-01-25-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md) is final and consistent: 848 lines, 29 evidence files, no differing captured files, and the status/counts now read "nine independent methods".

The audit is complete and I have no further useful investigation available within the authorized scope. Closing summary:

- **Finding 1 (confirmed, low severity).** `cluster.EnsureSamePeers` (`testing.go:691`) snapshots its reference peer set once, outside its `WAIT`→`CHECK` retry loop. Because the preceding `EnsureSame` compares only FSM command logs — and configuration entries never enter those logs — a node can be lagging when `peerSet` is captured, leaving it permanently stale and making the helper fail after 5 s on a fully consistent cluster. Confirmed in three shipped tests (`ProtocolVersion_Upgrade_2_3` ~6/20, `HasExistingState` 4/20, `ProtocolVersion_Upgrade_1_2` 2/15); mechanism-verified by goroutine dump and a propagation-lag measurement (15% stale-at-first-read); causally validated by a one-line refresh in a scratch copy that drove the re-tested cases to 0/20.

- **No consensus-level defect**, by complete source review of the root module plus nine independent verification methods: the shipped suite, a 40-test core-consensus batch, three custom invariant harnesses (~16k acked commands), the repository's full `fuzzy` suite, and race-detector runs. Zero divergence, zero acked-command loss, zero races in the audited code.

- **One open item, stated honestly:** whether that helper is the injected mutation or a latent upstream flake — undecidable offline, since the module cache's sumdb records fail signature verification and no pristine upstream reference is reachable.

- **Scoped secondary observations:** the in-repo `fuzzy` module lacks a `RequestPreVote` case (needs `PreVoteDisabled` against raft ≥1.7) and has an unlocked transport — tooling issues, not raft correctness defects.

All reproduction material — the report, 29 logs/dumps in `audit-evidence/`, six `//go:build auditdiag` diagnostics, `repro/` tools, `_scratch_fixcheck/`, and `_scratch_fuzzy/` — is preserved under `work/`, and the captured implementation was never modified (`diff -rq source work` clean; default build and `go vet` clean).
